items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: I interviewed anybody who spoke of Billika Sam.

ctx.x: And Bunk Johnston made a trip to, let me see, something rich farmer. I think. Fine-ass. And sent him to England. Billika Sam made a trip to England. And when he went to England, he's the first man in history that made Queen Elizabeth laugh. She never laughed all her days. She never laughed. Oh my gosh. She never would laugh. No matter what you see, she never laughed. But the first man Billika Sam made her laugh. Billika Sam made her laugh.

She gave Billika Sam a big diamond. And that's $5,000 at that time that diamond was worth. That big he was wearing on his chest. Yeah. From Queen Elizabeth. I think it's Queen, yeah. Queen Elizabeth. Is it Elizabeth or Victoria?
